page.overview:
What is Medicham?

Medicham is an /-type Pokémon, who is member of Team Meanies, that appears in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!

Medicham, along with Gengar and Ekans, is a part of Team Meanies. When the Whiscash Elder sent the teams to find Pichu's brother, Pikachu, Team Meanies went to Kecleon Brothers' store and bought everything. Soon after, the team snatched Team Go-Getters' berries and took off to the mission. However, Medicham, as well as the rest of the team, got attacked by the rampaging Skarmory and lost the battle. Team Go-Getters came and Medicham was offered a berry, which she ate.
